commands.description: Everything about the document in one call: mesh size and bounds, the list of parts (index, name, triangles, colour, bounds), the selection, animation clips and whether undo/redo are available. Call this first, and again after edits to check the result.
commands.name: get_status

commands.description: Raw geometry of one part (or the whole mesh when 'part' is omitted): vertex positions and triangles as vertex-index triples. For checking shapes; large meshes are cut off.

max_vertices.description: Most vertices to return (default 500, at most 2000).

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

commands.name: get_mesh_data

commands.description: Renders the model offscreen and returns a PNG image. The way to SEE what has been built - take one after every few edits, from more than one angle (try perspective, front, top and right).

azimuth.description: Perspective only: degrees around the model. 0 = seen from +Z (front), 90 = from +X (right). Default 35.

color_by_part.description: Give each part its own flat tint to tell them apart.

distance.description: Camera distance (perspective) or view height in world units (orthographic) when frame is false.

elevation.description: Perspective only: degrees above the horizon, -89 to 89. Default 25.

frame.description: Fit the whole mesh in view (default true). When false, 'target' and 'distance' set the camera.

shading.description: 'textured' shows part colours and is the default; 'solid' is neutral grey; 'wireframe' shows the triangles.

target.description: Point the camera looks at when frame is false.

view.description: Camera. 'perspective' orbits using azimuth/elevation; the others are orthographic looks straight down an axis (front looks toward -Z, right looks toward -X, top looks down).

wireframe_overlay.description: Draw the triangle edges over the shading.

commands.name: screenshot

commands.description: Discards the current mesh, skeleton, animations and undo history and starts empty. Cannot be undone.
commands.name: new_document

commands.description: Opens a mesh file (.rmesh, .obj, .fbx, .gltf, ...), replacing the document.

path.description: File path on the machine running the editor.

commands.name: load_mesh

commands.description: Merges another mesh file into the document as additional parts.

path.description: File path on the machine running the editor.

commands.name: append_mesh

commands.description: Saves the document in the engine's own .rmesh format (the extension is forced to .rmesh), with a .material file beside it.
commands.name: save_mesh

commands.description: Exports the document as a Wavefront .obj file.
commands.name: export_obj

commands.description: Exports the document as a binary glTF 2.0 file (.glb): one mesh with a primitive and a PBR material (colour, roughness, metalness) per part. Static geometry only. This is the format to hand a model to a game or another tool.

path.description: Where to write the file, e.g. /home/me/helicopter.glb.

commands.name: export_gltf

commands.description: Undoes the last edit(s).

steps.description: How many steps to go back (default 1).

commands.name: undo

commands.description: Redoes edits that were undone.

steps.description: How many steps to go back (default 1).

commands.name: redo

commands.description: Adds a basic solid as a new part, already placed and coloured. Every other shape is built from these: stretch a sphere with a non-uniform 'scale' for a fuselage, use boxes for blades and struts, cylinders for masts and skids. Returns the part's index, name and bounds.

color.description: Base colour as it should look (sRGB): "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b] / [r,g,b,a] with components 0..1.

height.description: Cylinder/cone/capsule height along Y. Default 1. A cylinder or cone is centred on its origin.

name.description: Name of the part (its material name). Use it later to refer to the part.

position.description: Where the part's origin goes. Default [0,0,0]. +Y is up.

radius.description: Sphere/cylinder/cone/capsule radius, torus major radius. Default 0.5.

replace.description: Start a new mesh instead of adding a part (default false).

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied about X first, then Y, then Z. Default [0,0,0].

scale.description: Number (uniform) or [x,y,z]. Default 1. Non-uniform scale turns a sphere into an ellipsoid.

size.description: Box size [x,y,z], or plane extent [x,_,z]. Default [1,1,1].

type.description: Shape. Box and plane use 'size'; sphere, cylinder, cone, capsule and torus use 'radius' (and 'height' / 'minor_radius').

commands.name: add_primitive

commands.description: Adds a part made by spinning an outline around the Y axis: nose cones, tapered booms, domes, hubs, fuel tanks - anything round that a primitive cannot give. Rotate it afterwards with 'rotation' to lay it along X or Z.

cap_end.description: Close an open last end with a disc (default true).

cap_start.description: Close an open first end with a disc (default true).

color.description: Base colour as it should look (sRGB): "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b] / [r,g,b,a] with components 0..1.

name.description: Name of the part (its material name). Use it later to refer to the part.

position.description: Where the part's origin goes. Default [0,0,0]. +Y is up.

profile.description: Outline as [radius, y] pairs from one end to the other, spun around the Y axis. A radius of 0 closes that end to a point. Example, a bullet nose: [[0,2],[0.4,1.8],[0.6,1],[0.6,0]].

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied about X first, then Y, then Z. Default [0,0,0].

scale.description: Number (uniform) or [x,y,z]. Default 1. Non-uniform scale turns a sphere into an ellipsoid.

commands.name: add_lathe

commands.description: Adds a part by stringing elliptical (or boxier) cross-sections along an axis - the way to model a fuselage, a tapering tail boom, a wing or a float that is not a straight solid. Far fewer calls and a smoother result than stacking primitives.

axis.description: Direction the shape runs along. Default 'z'.

cap_end.description: Close an open last end with a disc (default true).

cap_start.description: Close an open first end with a disc (default true).

color.description: Base colour as it should look (sRGB): "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b] / [r,g,b,a] with components 0..1.

name.description: Name of the part (its material name). Use it later to refer to the part.

position.description: Where the part's origin goes. Default [0,0,0]. +Y is up.

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied about X first, then Y, then Z. Default [0,0,0].

scale.description: Number (uniform) or [x,y,z]. Default 1. Non-uniform scale turns a sphere into an ellipsoid.

sections.description: Cross-sections in increasing 'at' order. The surface is drawn smoothly through them: a fuselage is a handful of sections from nose to tail, each with its own width and height.

at.description: Position of this cross-section along the axis.

exponent.description: Shape: 2 = ellipse (default), 4-6 = rounded box, 0.5-1 = pointed diamond.

height.description: Full height across the second cross axis (Y for axis z/x, Z for axis y). 0 pinches to a point.

offset.description: Shifts the section's centre across [first, second] axes - e.g. to make a tail boom rise.

width.description: Full width across the first cross axis (X for axis z/y, Y for axis x). 0 pinches to a point.

commands.name: add_loft

commands.description: Adds a part from raw vertices and triangles, for shapes none of the other add_* commands can describe. Normals are computed for you.

color.description: Base colour as it should look (sRGB): "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b] / [r,g,b,a] with components 0..1.

name.description: Name of the part (its material name). Use it later to refer to the part.

position.description: Where the part's origin goes. Default [0,0,0]. +Y is up.

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied about X first, then Y, then Z. Default [0,0,0].

scale.description: Number (uniform) or [x,y,z]. Default 1. Non-uniform scale turns a sphere into an ellipsoid.

smooth.description: Smooth normals across shared vertices (default true); false gives flat faces.

triangles.description: Triangles as [a,b,c] vertex indices, counter-clockwise seen from outside.

commands.name: add_mesh

commands.description: Moves, rotates and/or scales an existing part. 'position' is an offset added to where the part is now, not an absolute location; rotation and scale act about the pivot.

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

pivot.description: Point the rotation and scale act about. Default: the centre of the part's bounds.

pivot_origin.description: Use the world origin as the pivot instead.

position.description: Translation added to the part, [x,y,z]. Default [0,0,0].

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied about X first, then Y, then Z. Default [0,0,0].

scale.description: Number (uniform) or [x,y,z]. Default 1. Non-uniform scale turns a sphere into an ellipsoid.

commands.name: transform_part

commands.description: Copies a part. With 'mirror' the copy is the mirror image - the quick way to make the second skid, the other stub wing or the twin engine. 'position', 'rotation' and 'scale' are applied to the copy after mirroring; 'name'/'color' restyle only the copy.

color.description: Base colour as it should look (sRGB): "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b] / [r,g,b,a] with components 0..1.

mirror.description: Mirror the copy across the plane through the origin perpendicular to this axis (x = left/right twin).

name.description: Name of the part (its material name). Use it later to refer to the part.

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

position.description: Where the part's origin goes. Default [0,0,0]. +Y is up.

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied about X first, then Y, then Z. Default [0,0,0].

scale.description: Number (uniform) or [x,y,z]. Default 1. Non-uniform scale turns a sphere into an ellipsoid.

commands.name: duplicate_part

commands.description: Changes a part's name, colour, roughness or metalness.

color.description: Base colour as it should look (sRGB): "#rrggbb" or [r,g,b] / [r,g,b,a] with components 0..1.

name.description: Name of the part (its material name). Use it later to refer to the part.

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

commands.name: style_part

commands.description: Removes a part and its triangles.

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

commands.name: delete_part

commands.description: Hides or shows a part in the viewport and in screenshots (the geometry stays).

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

visible.description: true to show, false to hide.

commands.name: set_part_visible

commands.description: Keeps only one part, re-indexed to stand alone, and drops the rest.

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

commands.name: extract_part

commands.description: Selects vertices or faces so the edit commands (transform_selection, extrude, delete_selection, weld, smooth) know what to act on. Pick by index, by part, or by a world-space box. Returns the resulting selection.

action.description: set (default) replaces the selection; add / remove change it; clear, all, invert, grow, shrink and linked operate on what is selected.

box.description: Axis-aligned region in world space. Selects vertices inside it (vertex mode) or faces whose centre is inside it (face mode).

mode.description: Element type to select. Keeps the current mode when omitted.

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

commands.name: select

commands.description: What is selected now: mode, counts, the bounds of the selected vertices and the first few indices.
commands.name: get_selection

commands.description: Moves, rotates and/or scales the selected vertices (or the corners of the selected faces). Fails when nothing is selected, rather than touching the whole mesh.

pivot.description: Point rotation and scale act about. Default: the median of the selection.

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied about X first, then Y, then Z. Default [0,0,0].

scale.description: Number (uniform) or [x,y,z]. Default 1. Non-uniform scale turns a sphere into an ellipsoid.

commands.name: transform_selection

commands.description: Moves, rotates and/or scales the entire mesh (every part together).

pivot.description: Point rotation and scale act about. Default the world origin.

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied about X first, then Y, then Z. Default [0,0,0].

scale.description: Number (uniform) or [x,y,z]. Default 1. Non-uniform scale turns a sphere into an ellipsoid.

commands.name: transform_mesh

commands.description: Extrudes the selected faces along their normals by 'distance' and selects the new faces, so a second extrude continues from them. Needs a face selection.

distance.description: Distance along the face normals; negative sinks them.

commands.name: extrude

commands.description: Deletes the selected vertices or faces (per the selection mode).
commands.name: delete_selection

commands.description: Merges vertices closer than 'distance', removing cracks and duplicated seams.

selected_only.description: Only weld the selected vertices (default false).

commands.name: weld_vertices

commands.description: Relaxes vertex positions toward their neighbours (Laplacian smoothing).
commands.name: smooth_vertices

commands.description: Rebuilds the vertex normals from the triangles.

smooth.description: Average across shared vertices (default true); false = flat faces.

commands.name: recalculate_normals

commands.description: Turns triangles inside out - the fix for a part that renders dark or disappears from outside. Whole mesh unless 'part' is given.

part.description: A part, by its index (integer) or by its name (string).

commands.name: flip_winding

commands.description: Re-centres the whole mesh on the origin; 'ground' also drops the lowest point to y = 0 (what a model that stands on the floor wants).

ground.description: Centre on X/Z and rest on y = 0 (default false).

commands.name: center_mesh

commands.description: Cuts the mesh with an axis-aligned plane and keeps one side.

offset.description: Plane position along that axis. Default 0.

commands.name: bisect

commands.description: Replaces the mesh with its convex hull (a collision proxy).
commands.name: convex_hull

commands.description: Generates texture coordinates for the whole mesh by projection.

u_tiles.description: Planar: texture repeat per unit; else repeats around. Default 1.

v_tiles.description: Cylindrical/spherical repeats along the height. Default 1.

commands.name: generate_uv

commands.description: Unwraps non-overlapping UV islands (xatlas). Splits vertices at seams.

resolution.description: Atlas size in texels; 0 (default) = one page, automatic.

target.description: Write to the texture UVs (default) or to the second set used for lightmaps.

commands.name: unwrap_uv

commands.description: Reduces the triangle count while keeping the shape.

error.description: Largest allowed deviation as a fraction of the mesh. Default 0.01.

ratio.description: Fraction of triangles to keep, 0.05-1. Default 0.5.

commands.name: simplify

commands.description: Welds duplicate vertices and reorders for GPU cache and overdraw efficiency.
commands.name: optimize

commands.description: Chooses the animation clip and frame shown, and starts or stops playback. Only meaningful for a rigged mesh with clips (see get_status).

clip.description: Index of the clip to activate.

commands.name: set_animation
